FiniteListFixedPoint:
∀ {α : Type} (f : List α → List α) (ambient : List α)
    (hmono : ∀ L M, L ⊆ M → f L ⊆ f M)
    (hbound : ∀ L, f L ⊆ ambient) (n : ℕ) (hn : ambient.length ≤ n),
    ∀ x, x ∈ f^[n] ([] : List α) ↔ x ∈ f (f^[n] [])
MeasuredBoundedClauseUniverse:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    ∃ generate : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) generate ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ∃ U : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, generate (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U ∧
        ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, c ∈ U ↔ c.length ≤ k ∧ c ⊆ φ.flatMap id
MeasuredResolutionRound:
let pair := fun (p q : List Bool) => List.replicate p.length true ++ false :: (p ++ q)
    ∃ advance : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) advance ∧
      ∀ φ U old : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, advance (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) (pair (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF U) (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF old))) =
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (U.filter (fun c => @decide
          ((∃ a ∈ φ, a.toFinset = c.toFinset) ∨
            ∃ a ∈ old, ∃ b ∈ old, PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsResolvent a.toFinset b.toFinset c.toFinset)
          (Classical.propDecidable _)))
MeasuredResolutionSaturation:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    ∃ derive : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) derive ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ∃ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, derive (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ ∧
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsDerivation
          {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset) ∧
        (∀ d ∈ ρ.map List.toFinset, Finset.card d ≤ k) ∧
        ([] ∈ ρ ↔ ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ),
          PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
            {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} π ∧
          ∀ d ∈ π, Finset.card d ≤ k)
MeasuredBoundedWidthRefutationSearch:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
        (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) ≠ [] ↔ ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ),
          PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
            {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} π ∧
          ∀ d ∈ π, Finset.card d ≤ k) ∧
        (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) ≠ [] → ∃ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ ∧
          PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
            {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset) ∧
          ∀ d ∈ ρ.map List.toFinset, Finset.card d ≤ k)
ExactBoundedResolutionWidth:
∀ (k : ℕ),
    {x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ∃ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ),
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
          {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} π ∧
        ∀ d ∈ π, Finset.card d ≤ k} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactResolutionRefutationVerifier:
PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair
      {p : List Bool × List Bool | ∃ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = p.1 ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF ρ = p.2 ∧
        PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
          {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset)} ∧
    (∀ (φ ρ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation
      {d : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause ℕ | ∃ c ∈ φ, c.toFinset = d} (ρ.map List.toFinset) → ¬ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)
